n01.text: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away....
n01.caption: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away....

c01.text: It is a time of rebellion. From a hidden base among the outer stars, a ragged fleet has struck the first real blow against the Galactic Empire.
c01.caption: It is a time of rebellion. From a hidden base among the outer stars, a ragged fleet has struck the first real blow against the Galactic Empire.

c02.text: In the confusion of that battle, rebel agents seized the plans to the Empire's terrible new battle station. A moon-sized fortress, with power enough to shatter a world.
c02.caption: In the confusion of that battle, rebel agents seized the plans to the Empire's terrible new battle station. A moon-sized fortress, with power enough to shatter a world.

c03.text: Now, hunted across the galaxy, Princess Leia runs for home with the stolen plans hidden aboard her ship. And with them, the last hope of freedom that remains.
c03.caption: Now, hunted across the galaxy, Princess Leia runs for home with the stolen plans hidden aboard her ship. And with them, the last hope of freedom that remains.

n02.text: Above the desert world of Tatooine, the chase came to an end.
n02.caption: Above the desert world of Tatooine, the chase came to an end.

n03.text: They had run out of sky.
n03.caption: They had run out of sky.

o01.text: Tractor beam engaged. Prepare a boarding party.
o01.caption: Tractor beam engaged. Prepare a boarding party.
o01.speaker: OFFICER

n04.text: They held the corridor for eleven seconds.
n04.caption: They held the corridor for eleven seconds.

v01.text: The plans were transmitted to this ship. Find them.
v01.caption: The plans were transmitted to this ship. Find them.
v01.speaker: VADER

v02.text: Tear this vessel apart, piece by piece.
v02.caption: Tear this vessel apart, piece by piece.
v02.speaker: VADER

n05.text: While the Empire searched the upper decks, the princess found the only couriers left to her.
n05.caption: While the Empire searched the upper decks, the princess found the only couriers left to her.

l01.text: Take this. Get it off the ship. Everything depends on you now.
l01.caption: Take this. Get it off the ship. Everything depends on you now.
l01.speaker: LEIA

p01.text: Oh, this is madness! Absolute madness!
p01.caption: Oh, this is madness! Absolute madness!
p01.speaker: C-3PO

p02.text: Wait! Where are you going? We are certainly not authorised to leave!
p02.caption: Wait! Where are you going? We are certainly not authorised to leave!
p02.speaker: C-3PO

n06.text: One escape pod, one little astromech, and the whole future of the galaxy rattling around inside him.
n06.caption: One escape pod, one little astromech, and the whole future of the galaxy rattling around inside him.

n07.text: They came down in the dune sea, under two suns and no shade at all.
n07.caption: They came down in the dune sea, under two suns and no shade at all.

p03.text: We are going to be melted down. I just know it.
p03.caption: We are going to be melted down. I just know it.
p03.speaker: C-3PO

n08.text: And so the fate of a galaxy went walking across the sand, arguing all the way.
n08.caption: And so the fate of a galaxy went walking across the sand, arguing all the way.

n09.text: The plans reached the Rebellion. The Rebellion found one weakness. A thermal exhaust port, two metres wide.
n09.caption: The plans reached the Rebellion. The Rebellion found one weakness. A thermal exhaust port, two metres wide.

n10.text: Two metres wide. And that was enough.
n10.caption: Two metres wide. And that was enough.

n11.text: A galaxy far, far away. Built, brick by brick, out of nothing but code.
n11.caption: A galaxy far, far away. Built, brick by brick, out of nothing but code.
